name: Justin 王
title: 软件工程学生 · 全栈开发
headline: 热爱构建实用、高效的Web应用，关注系统集成与工业技术应用。
headline_en: Passionate about building practical, efficient web apps with a focus on system integration and industrial technology applications.
bio: 卡尔加里大学软件工程学生，ENSF项目。拥有多个全栈项目实践经验，涵盖React/Next.js、Go、C#/ASP.NET Core、Python及SQL数据库。对AI应用和工业数据采集与系统集成有浓厚兴趣，自学并实现过Knowledge Base, RAG, Modbus TCP通信与SCADA风格数据采集。善于快速学习新技术，具备独立交付完整项目的自驱力，熟练使用AI工具提升开发效率。。
bio_en: Software Engineering student at the University of Calgary (ENSF program). Hands-on experience across full-stack projects using React/Next.js, Go, C#/ASP.NET Core, Python, and SQL databases. Strong interest in AI applications and industrial data acquisition and system integration — self-taught Knowledge Base and RAG implementations, Modbus TCP communication, and SCADA-style data collection pipeline. Quick learner of new technologies, self-driven to deliver complete projects independently, and proficient in leveraging AI tools to enhance development efficiency.
location: 卡尔加里, 阿尔伯塔
